results.query: 2025 California Fire Code 1205.5.1 maintained vegetative surface under photovoltaic arrays
results.snippet: A maintained vegetative surface or a noncombustible base, approved by the fire code official, shall be installed and maintained under the photovoltaic arrays and associated electrical equipment installations.
